P7668.corridor_notes: Guangxi DRC approval 桂发改油气〔2024〕525号 (dated 2024-07-15, published 2024-07-26; project code 2309-450000-04-01-929950; owner: 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司广西分公司 / PipeChina Guangxi Branch) for '南宁-凭祥支线（崇左-凭祥段）天然气管道项目' states verbatim: '管道项目起点位于崇左输气站（扩建），沿线途经崇左市江州区、宁明县、龙州县、凭祥市，止于凭祥末站。管道全长约100公里' — i.e. starts at Chongzuo Gas Transmission Station (an expansion of an existing station), runs through Jiangzhou District, Ningming County, and Longzhou County, and ends at Pingxiang Terminal Station in Pingxiang City. Length ~100 km matches GEM's 100.10 km almost exactly; D406.4mm pipe, 6.3 MPa design pressure, 5.03×10^8 m3/yr design capacity, 3 stations (2 new + 1 expansion), total investment 514.59 million yuan. This 崇左-凭祥段 (Chongzuo-Pingxiang segment) is the western portion of the broader 南宁-凭祥支线 (Nanning-Pingxiang branch); a separate, already-commissioned eastern portion (南宁-崇左段, Nanning-Chongzuo section) went into trial operation 2025-06-03 per multiple June-2025 news reports (toutiao/sohu/qq/xinhuanet) — those articles describe a different segment and are NOT used as endpoint refs here, only as broader corridor context. fgw.gxzf.gov.cn itself is geo-blocked (ConnectTimeout on direct fetch and via url_verifier); cited via the archive.org snapshot per project convention.
P7668.researcher_notes: GEM's null Start/EndLocation resolved with high confidence: the official Guangxi DRC project-approval document (archived, verified) names both endpoint stations explicitly and its stated county sequence (Jiangzhou→Ningming→Longzhou→Pingxiang) and length (~100 km) match SegmentName ('Chongzuo-Pingxiang segment') and GEM's LengthMergedKm (100.10) closely. A second platform (qianlima.com) republishes the same underlying approval (same approval number 桂发改油气〔2024〕525号) — not a fully independent source, but corroborates the project exists and the length. Status='proposed' in GEM is consistent with the 2024-07 approval date and no commissioning news found for this specific segment (as opposed to the already-commissioned Nanning-Chongzuo segment to its east).
